run_gpu_gaussian_blur: run gpu_gaussian_blur on a numpy image array with kernel size and sigma parameters
build_gpu_sharpen: build unsharp-mask sharpening on an image array using gpu_sharpen with strength and sigma
create_gpu_add_weighted: create a blended image result by adding two images with alpha, beta, and gamma weights via gpu_add_weighted
test_gpu_resize: test gpu_resize on an image array with target dimensions and interpolation method
refactor_gpu_cvt_color: refactor color space conversion on an image array using gpu_cvt_color with OpenCV color codes
review_gpu_flip: review gpu_flip on an image array with horizontal, vertical, or both flip codes
summarize_is_gpu_accelerated: summarize whether CUDA GPU acceleration is available via is_gpu_accelerated
